outcomes.interpretation: Supplied reference outcomes; correctness and population representativeness are not established.

comparison.scope: matched supplied predictions; no isolated causal model or generalization claim

findings.message: Some related breakdowns are withheld under the selected disclosure policy.

coverage.analytical_scope: Completed admitted populations; exact coverage is retained in the protected bundle.
limitations: Independent evaluation is evidence presence, not proof of improvement or future coverage.
Reapplication is applied-but-unvalidated until this application receives a qualifying independent assessment.
Conformal coverage is marginal under exchangeable scores and independent fixed upstream choices.
Cluster inference does not establish conformal validity. Selective labels limit population claims.
Fixed-artifact intervals exclude training, fitting and selection variability.
Observed separation checks apply only to supplied identities; external provenance remains declared.
Sampled resource controls can overshoot and are not capacity guarantees.

inference.conditioning: Frozen fitted artifacts; excludes fitting and selection variability.

cg2.assessment_policy: Independent evaluation applies only to the exact method/application/population assessed. Reapplication is unvalidated.
cg2.population_policy: Common inputs and paired outputs are distinct; native metrics are not substituted for matched comparisons.
